telegram.title: Telegram setup
telegram.description: Bot token, chat linking and Telegram Business setup on one page.

steps.title: Create or choose a bot
steps.description: Open @BotFather, create a bot or reuse an existing one, and copy the token.

steps.title: Paste the token here and validate it
steps.description: Save the token after validation so Airi can register the webhook automatically.

steps.title: Link a private or group chat
steps.description: Use the generated deep link or send /start with the source key to attach the chat to this workspace.

steps.title: Optionally enable Telegram Business
steps.description: Add the same bot in Telegram Business settings and enable reply permissions so business chats arrive in the same integration.

tips: If the webhook is inactive, refresh the status and register it again from this page.
If group messages are missing, disable privacy mode for the bot in BotFather.
Run /status in the bot chat after linking to confirm the workspace mapping.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp setup
whatsapp.description: Choose the connection method here and finish the Meta steps without leaving the integrations page.

steps.title: Prepare the Meta business account
steps.description: Sign in with the Meta account that manages your business. Meta can create the WhatsApp Business account and add the phone number during signup.

steps.title: Choose Cloud API or the Business app
steps.description: Cloud API is the default for new numbers. Choose the Business app to keep using the WhatsApp Business app on your phone.

steps.title: Finish Meta permissions and number selection
steps.description: Approve the requested access, pick the right business account, and confirm the phone number that should connect to Airi.

steps.title: Test the connection in Customer chats
steps.description: Send a message to the connected number and check that the conversation appears in Customer chats.

tips: Reconnect from this page if the token is close to expiration or already expired.
If Meta says the business account or phone number is missing, finish that setup in Meta Business Manager first.
Choose the Business app option only for a number that already runs on the WhatsApp Business app.

nextSteps.title: Next steps
nextSteps.description: Use the connected mode below. Open status only when you need Meta's live checks.

coexistence.title: The WhatsApp Business mobile app stays with you

steps.title: Chat history for the last 6 months
steps.description: History will load automatically if you selected this option during the Meta connection.

coexistence.limitationsTitle: Not available in Coexistence. To get access to them, reconnect to Cloud API above, but you will lose access to the mobile app.

cloud_api.label: Full Cloud API
cloud_api.title: Manage the number from airi.chat
cloud_api.description: The number works via Meta Cloud API for automation, templates, and scale.

steps.title: Check number readiness
steps.description: The status below must show a confirmed number, approved name, and ready webhooks.

steps.title: Send a live test
steps.description: Message the number and check that the chat appears in Customer chats.

steps.title: Enable additional features separately
steps.description: Catalogs, marketing messages, and calls are configured separately.

limitations: WhatsApp Business app is not used for replies

instagram.title: Instagram setup
instagram.description: Keep the account connection flow and the setup steps inside the integration details instead of jumping out to a separate guide.

steps.title: Use a professional Instagram account
steps.description: Make sure the account is Business or Creator and connected to the correct Facebook page in Meta.

steps.title: Choose the right login path
steps.description: Use Facebook Login for Instagram when the account is already managed through Meta. Use direct Instagram login only when that flow matches your app setup.

steps.title: Grant messaging permissions
steps.description: Complete the Meta consent flow and confirm the account returns the messaging and publish scopes your workspace needs.

steps.title: Verify messages and profile snapshot
steps.description: After connection, confirm the business profile details load here and that inbound messages arrive in Customer chats.

tips: If the token is close to expiry, reconnect from this page before the account loses access.
If publish permissions are missing, reconnect with the correct Meta scopes instead of patching the account manually.
Keep the Instagram account linked to the right Facebook page, otherwise the API can connect successfully but still miss messaging features.
